Hints explain the line they used ('4 x ? = 20, so 5'), so you learn instead of just filling squares. Plays offline, no account. Free with ads.

posts.name: Roleframe.ai
posts.tagline: Your career workspace, from resume to interview

Live checks flag wording, formatting issues and missing keywords as you edit, and Remi helps you fix them with changes you approve. Save jobs with the Chrome extension, track your applications and practice interviews based on your resume and the job posting. It all stays together in Roleframe.

posts.name: How to split a single bill
posts.tagline: Split a bill so tax and tip follow what each person ordered.
posts.description: Dividing a restaurant bill by the number of people is easy and usually wrong. The person who had a salad and tap water pays for someone else's steak and three cocktails. Split Single Bill works out what each person owes based on what they actually ordered, and makes the tax, the tip and the service charge follow the same logic. Add the items, say who shared what, and it does the rest. Two people splitting a plate of chips get half each. Tax is spread across the items that were taxed. The tip...

posts.name: Seal
posts.tagline: Letters and passwords your family opens after you're dead.
posts.description: Seal is an iPhone app for the letters and passwords your family will need after you die. Write envelopes for the people you love, seal them with real cryptography (no backend, no account, open source), and they open automatically after a long silence from you. New in 1.2: your family doesn't need an iPhone anymore. Anyone holding the security key can open their envelopes from any browser at sealmessenger.com. Free to try, $29.99 lifetime.
